additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Mr. Florian has raised a ticket regarding a charger that is not operational for some time. Please check on site if the problem is the router 1 or if the charger needs to be restore-configured. I send the config files in attachment.
Do not flash the CFAST unless the restore config doesn't work. Remember that you need the keyboard to select the boot option.
Please take a spare router in case it's faulty.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0436421 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
